name: orcamcp
description: Slice with your own OrcaSlicer and user presets, on any of your printers: grams, print time, G-code, batch slicing and printer comparison.
long_description: Uses the OrcaSlicer CLI with your own user presets (including presets that inherit from system ones, which the CLI cannot resolve on its own in OrcaSlicer 2.5). Works on a private copy of your presets; never writes to your OrcaSlicer folder and never overwrites files.

tools.name: list_printers
tools.description: Your printers, nozzles and which one is active

tools.name: list_profiles
tools.description: Your printer, process and filament presets (optionally only those compatible with a printer)

tools.name: model_info
tools.description: Size, volume and mesh check without slicing

tools.name: slice
tools.description: Slice models with your presets: grams, time, optional G-code/3MF

tools.name: slice_folder
tools.description: Slice every model in a folder and write a CSV

tools.name: compare_printers
tools.description: Slice the same model on several printers and compare

default_printer.title: Default printer preset
default_printer.description: Name or part of it, e.g. 'AD5M Pro 0.4'. Empty = simplest user printer. You can change the active printer anytime by asking Claude (set_printer).
